title: Safety is Nowhere
description: Dreams are real and so are nightmares. The world is corrupted, find the source of abnormalities.
body:
> THE DARKNESS SPREADS. YOU BETTER BE READY, I'VE BEEN WAITING FOR THIS MOMENT FOR TOO LONG NOW.

<center>
  
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd56fc7c7275e42386ec9982ac3d297b82a09101.png)

</center>

Prepare for a not so ordinary survival experience with new additions that will essentially make your life harder. The rules have changed, make sure to survive for long enough before they decide it's too late. Prove yourself worthy.

<center>
  
  # Things you need to know before playing with Safety is Nowhere
  </center>

- This mod can be unfair, sometimes willingly
- Safety is quite literally Nowhere
- Game will get progressively harder, the stronger you get
- Vanilla beds and furnaces are disabled, use their modded alternatives
- Progression is done only in Overworld, Nether and The End are disabled from entering in Survival. For now, your goal is to make a Nether portal and craft a Dimension Transmitter for it
- You might want to use JEI to figure out what you need to do
